other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via global aggregations before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Aggregating feature statistics (e.g., mean, standard deviation, value counts) over the combined train and test dataset leaks test set distribution information into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated pipeline with appropriate multi-model ensembling, out-of-fold target encoding, and custom deep learning architectures. However, it applies text feature extraction (TF-IDF/SVD) and global groupby aggregations on the combined train and test sets, causing data leakage. Additionally, it tunes ensemble weights and class multipliers on the OOF predictions without nested CV, biasing the reported performance upward.
